events.title: Will Williams-Sonoma (WSM) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report?
events.body: Williams-Sonoma (WSM) has an impressive earnings surprise history and currently possesses the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely beat in its next quarterly report.

events.title: Floor & Dcor (FND) Misses Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
events.body: Floor & Dcor (FND) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -10.84% and -2.78%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
